title: Normalize feature-toggle metadata and remove deprecated admin endpoints
creator: Emily Chen
description: Background: Over time multiple ad-hoc schemas and admin routes were introduced for feature toggles and rollout configuration. We have two active flag schemas (feature_flags.v1, feature_flags.v2) and several legacy admin endpoints (/admin/flags, /api/admin/flags_v0, /internal/rollout). This divergence causes confusion for SDKs, duplicate code paths, and prevents safe automation of rollouts and auditing. Goal: harmonize flag metadata into feature_flags.v2, migrate consumers, and remove the legacy admin endpoints and the v1 schema artifacts. This ticket focuses on the engineering migration, API removal, and rollout of changes with minimal customer disruption.
acceptance_criteria: All active feature toggles are represented in feature_flags.v2 and validated via schema checks
Legacy endpoints /api/admin/flags_v0 and /internal/rollout are removed from the codebase and routing layer
SDKs and Console use the v2 schema exclusively (backwards-compat compatibility shim removed)
Automated migration script has run in staging and production with <=5% transient 500s and a clear rollback path
Audit logs show parity between v1 and v2 for a 7-day comparison window before deletion
Docs, runbooks, and UE links updated and a changelog entry published
work_items: Inventory: generate list of endpoints, services and scheduled jobs referencing v1 flags (script: scripts/flag-inventory.sh)
Write migration script to transform v1 flag records to v2 canonical representation (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4021)
Add CI schema validator for feature_flags.v2 and fail builds that produce v1 shape
Deploy compatibility shim that translates v1 => v2 for 2 weeks (feature gate behind 'flags-migration-shim')
Run gradual migration in staging, then prod with canary traffic (10% -> 50% -> 100%)
Remove routing entries and controller handlers for /api/admin/flags_v0 and /internal/rollout after migration window
Update SDKs and client libs to remove v1 code paths and bump major where necessary
Publish console UI change and update admin docs, changelog, and migration guide
rollback_plan: If errors exceed thresholds (>=5% new 5xxs or feature parity mismatch), immediately revert to the compatibility shim and pause endpoint removals. Rollback steps: (1) re-enable 'flags-migration-shim' via feature toggle; (2) re-deploy routing config to reintroduce the legacy endpoint proxies; (3) run parity reconciliation job to re-sync any lost entries; (4) open incident and notify affected teams.
monitoring_queries: alerts.flags_migration_error_rate: query alerts where service:flags-migration and status>=500
